connectorUiConfig.title: MailGuard 365 Connector (Push)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The MailGuard 365 connector provides the capability to push mail-security event data from MailGuard 365 directly into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern. This connector ingests message metadata, sender/recipient details, spam/virus scoring, and attachment information into a custom Log Analytics table for analysis, alerting, and visualization.

sampleQueries.query:
MG365ThreatData_CL
 | where Virus == true
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: MG365ThreatData_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
MG365ThreatData_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
MG365ThreatData_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra
customs.description: Permission to create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID. Typically requires Entra ID Application Developer role or higher.

customs.name: Microsoft Azure
customs.description: Permission to assign Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on data collection rule (DCR). Typically requires Azure RBAC Owner or User Access Administrator role.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM Resources and Provide the Required Permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables MailGuard 365 to push mail-security event data directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application 
Clicking "Deploy" will create a Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR), then create a dedicated Entra application, link the DCR to it, and generate a client secret. This lets MailGuard 365 push data securely to the DCR using an Entra token.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure MailGuard 365
instructionSteps.description: Copy the following values into MailGuard 365 admin console → Settings → Integration so MailGuard 365 knows where to push data for this tenant.

parameters.label: Entra App Registration Application ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the App Registration Application ID

parameters.label: Entra App Registration Secret
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the App Registration Secret

parameters.label: Data Collection Endpoint Uri
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Data Collection Endpoint Uri

parameters.label: Data Collection Rule Immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Data Collection Rule Immutable ID

parameters.content:
#### Configure MailGuard 365
Enter the values above into your MailGuard 365 admin console under Settings → Integration, to enable message data push to Microsoft Sentinel.

Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

Strengthen your Microsoft 365 email security against advanced zero-day phishing, ransomware & BEC attacks with MailGuard 365 enhanced email security. This Microsoft Sentinel Solution enables you to ingest threat data from MailGuard 365 via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API, using a dedicated Entra application.

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1, Hunting Queries: 3
